collateral: Euler: the collateral vault with the most attributed debt at the run start (data/vaults/euler_v2/*/borrow_distribution.csv); Silo: the paired silo's token
kept: step two: some curated vault holding >= 10k USD in the market had L(t) < 5% on a day end inside the run while L(t) with this market liquid would be >= 5%
opened_in_creation_block: the run starts in the block that created the market (one-block supply-and-borrow loops such as the 720 Base cbBTC/GMORPHO markets)
oracle: data/registry/oracles/ (Silo: the paired silo's solvency oracle)
peak_supply_usd: max over the run's days of supply x the loan token's daily close
pinned_share_prior_180d: share of the 180 day ends before the run with end-of-day utilization >= 99% (markets pinned by design score high)
run: starts at the first panel row with utilization >= threshold, ends at the first later row below it; open at the head = ongoing_at_head
step_one: utilization >= 0.99 for >= 72 h, peak supply >= 1,000,000 USD
utilization: Morpho/Moolah totalBorrowAssets / totalSupplyAssets; Euler totalBorrows / (cash + totalBorrows); Silo debt / collateral (protected excluded)
what: every step-one lock-up run on the 14 pairs, with the step-two outcome (kept)
